title: Rainfall-associated expansion of frog active communities is more boundary-biased than uniform activation predicts
description: Reproducibility package for a Journal of Animal Ecology Research Article on rainfall-associated expansion of behaviourally realized frog communities, explicit species × site allocation, and uniform-activation comparators. The archive contains the anonymized manuscript, frozen analysis provenance, deterministic figures and analysis code. Raw third-party datasets are not redistributed.
